name: Misty Blue
source:
is about a young musician named Kazuya Mizukami. After 4 years of studying music abroad, he returns to Japan and tries to sort out a new music deal - but somehow he gets mixed up in a murder case, and amongst other things.

[From [url=http://pixelmenu.22web.net/features/enix/enix1.html]Japan Adventure Attack[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕年轻音乐家水上和哉展开。他在国外学习音乐四年后回到日本，尝试洽谈一份新的音乐合约，却不知为何卷入了一桩谋杀案，以及其他种种事件。

[摘自[url=http://pixelmenu.22web.net/features/enix/enix1.html]Japan Adventure Attack[/url]]
